title: Okta Pricing 2026: Full Cost Breakdown and Hidden Fees
summary: Okta pricing varies by plan and charges per user. Compare the available tiers and their costs to determine which edition matches your requirements.
body_markdown:
## Hidden costs and limits buyers hit after signing


### The seven cost lines and where to check them


After signing, buyers hit minimums, add-on products, API rate limits, Workflows caps, paid support and services, and renewal uplift, so the written quote is where you pin each one down.


A minimum is a contract term, not a docs entry, so product minimums live in the written quote and order form. Premium support is described in the support tiers Okta publishes, which you match against what the quote lists.


Add-on products are on the product pages for each capability, compared line by line with the quote.


### Where Okta limits and services are documented


API rate limits are on the rate limits pages in Okta's developer documentation. Workflows caps are in the Okta Workflows documentation on usage and execution limits.


Services belong in the statement of work, if onboarding or migration help is included. Renewal uplift is in the renewal and pricing clauses of the master agreement.


### How minimums and bundling move the bill


When products are separate for each capability, the plan you priced may not include the feature you need, and each missing feature becomes another line item. Ask for a quote that lists every product by name, then check each against Okta's product pages.


### API and Workflows usage limits


When a bulk onboarding or a nightly sync hits the ceiling, it can stall, because rate limits cap how fast your own scripts and integrations can call Okta.


Workflows caps limit how many automated runs you get, which matters because deprovisioning a leaver across many apps often needs automation beyond what the base product does.


You can build that with Okta Workflows or with a separate workflow tool, but either way you're pricing runs, not just users.


If the real need is joiner, mover and leaver steps across your apps,[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) can run those workflows alongside whichever identity provider you pick, and it counts the run, not the steps inside it.


A ten-step offboarding flow costs 1 credit, the same as the two-step workaround it replaced, so adding steps inside one flow does not raise the bill. Zapier's per-task billing is where that stops being true.


### Support, services and renewal


The default support tier may not match the response times your team assumes, and premium support's a separate purchase.


**Year two is when renewal uplift shows up** , which makes it the least visible cost. Ask for the uplift in writing, and treat a refusal to state it as part of the price.
